title: Which machine is free first?
hook: The currently lighter machine may still receive an awkward final job.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Offline optimum versus online decisions; cost and approximation ratio.
doesNotKnow: Assign each arriving job to the currently least-loaded identical machine and compare makespan with lower bounds.

misconception: Minimizing each job's current finish time always gives the globally best makespan.
objective: Assign each arriving job to the currently least-loaded identical machine and compare makespan with lower bounds.

claims.text: The greedy scheduler reacts to current loads without seeing later arrivals. Both the longest single job and total work divided by machine count lower-bound every schedule. A different arrival order can improve this algorithm even though the job multiset is unchanged.
